# Repositories

The repositories that run a field's query against the session, in sync and async variants.

## `StrawchemyAsyncRepository` {#strawchemy-repository-strawberry-_async-StrawchemyAsyncRepository}

[source](https://github.com/gazorby/strawchemy/blob/v0.24.0/src/strawchemy/repository/strawberry/_async.py#L32)

```python
StrawchemyAsyncRepository(type: type[T], info: Info[Any, Any], root_aggregations: bool = False, auto_snake_case: bool = True, query_hook: QueryHook[Any] | Sequence[QueryHook[Any]] | None = None, session_getter: AsyncSessionGetter = default_session_getter, session: AnyAsyncSession | None = None, filter_statement: Select[tuple[Any]] | None = None, execution_options: dict[str, Any] | None = None, deterministic_ordering: bool = False, default_order_by: builtins.list[OrderByExpr] = list()) -> None
```

Asynchronous strawberry implementation for GraphQL data access.

This class provides asynchronous methods for querying and mutating data
through GraphQL, using SQLAlchemy's asynchronous API under the hood.

**Parameters:**

Name | Type | Description | Default
---- | ---- | ----------- | -------
`type` | <code>[type](#strawchemy-repository-strawberry-_async-StrawchemyAsyncRepository-type)[T]</code> | The Strawberry GraphQL type this strawberry works with | *required*
`info` | <code>Info[Any, Any]</code> | The GraphQL resolver info object | *required*
`session_getter` | <code>AsyncSessionGetter</code> | Callable to get an async database session | <code>default_session_getter</code>
`session` | <code>AnyAsyncSession \| None</code> | Optional explicit async database session to use | <code>None</code>
`filter_statement` | <code>Select[tuple[Any]] \| None</code> | Optional base SQLAlchemy select statement to apply to all queries | <code>None</code>
`execution_options` | <code>dict[str, Any] \| None</code> | Optional execution options for SQLAlchemy | <code>None</code>
`deterministic_ordering` | <code>bool</code> | Whether to ensure deterministic ordering of results | <code>False</code>
